newsitem.title: UK: Matra BAe Dynamics - no Storm Shadow exports.
newsitem.headline: Matra BAe Dynamics - no Storm Shadow exports.

text.p: Matra BAe Dynamics said in a statement on Wednesday that there would be no export sales opportunities for its Storm Shadow anti-attack missile.
Matra BAe Dynamics is a 50-50 joint venture between British Aerospace Plc and the Matra arm of France's Lagardere SCA.

The firm, which is Europe's largest guided weapons business, issued a statement on Tuesday concerning the Storm Shadow, which quoted chief executive officer Noel Forgeard as saying, "We also believe that there are good export prospects for the weapon."
However, the company's Paris unit issued a fresh statement on Wednesday, which denied that there were any export opportunities for the air-launched cruise stealth missile.

"This type of missile is, above all, reserved for the sovereignty missions of the United Kingdom (Storm Shadow programme) and France (Scalp E.G. programme)," a spokesman from the firm's Paris office said in the statement.
The company signed a 700 million pounds contract on Tuesday with Britain's Ministry of Defence to develop and produce the Storm Shadow missile, which is based on Matra's Apache weapon.
